faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Giridih West Forest Division Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 21 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Giridih West Forest Division Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 JRF, 1 SRF.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Giridih West Forest Division Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 21 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Office of the Divisional Forest Officer, Giridih West Forest Division, Giridih.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 30000 per month for JRF, 35000 per month for SRF.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: JRF: CSIR-UGC NET/GATE qualified, Postgraduate in Forestry/Ecology/Botany/Environmental Science/Sociology/Statistics/Watershed Management/Economics or allied disciplines. SRF: CSIR-UGC NET/GATE qualified, Postgraduate with minimum 2 years' research experience in Forestry/Ecology/Statistics/Wildlife Biology or allied disciplines, or pursuing Ph.D. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No travel allowance will be paid for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview. Selection of JRF/SRF by Walk in Interview. Decision of the Divisional Forest Officer will be final.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The engagement is for a limited time and purely temporary. It may be ended at any time without prior notice. Candidates will never claim regular appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Protected and reserved forests of various forest ranges of Giridih West Forest Division, Giridih.
